sloka: तं प्रयान्तं समुद्वीक्ष्य सुरसा वाक्यमब्रवीत् ।बलं जिज्ञासमाना वै नागमाता हनूमतः ॥५-१-१५८॥
transliteration: taṁ prayāntaṁ samudvīkṣya surasā vākyamabravīt ।balaṁ jijñāsamānā vai nāgamātā hanūmataḥ ॥5-1-158॥

translations.english: Surasa, mother of serpents, observing that Hanuman was attempting to escape, said this in order to gauge his strength:
